business_summary: Borosil Limited manufactures, sells, and trades in consumer ware products in India. The company offers laboratory glassware, including beakers, bottles, burettes, cones, condensers, cylinders, dessiciators, dishes, distilling apparatus, flasks, funnels, funnels, filtration assembly, volumetric flask, gas generator, jars, kettles, pipettes, tubes, HPLC VIALS, microscope slides, and lab accessories, as well as pharmaceutical packaging. It also provides consumer products, such as glass serve wear products, opalware dinner sets, kitchen appliances, storage products, glass lunch boxes, and stainless-steel vacuum insulated flasks and bottles, as well as solar glass. In addition, the company offers home decor, gas stoves, fine optical table wear, stainless-steel cookware, pressure cookers, kadai, frying pans, vacuum-insulated flasks. It provides its products under the Larah, LabQuest, and Borosil brand names. The company distributes through traditional crockery stores, modern retail outlets, e-commerce and quick commerce platforms, and website. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Hopewell Tableware Limited. Borosil Limited was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India.
